fields.Issue: Detector saturation on consecutive scans at 40 mA tube current
fields.Recommended Action: SEM warm-up procedure: 30 min. Steps: (1) Turn on filament, (2) Pump chamber to <5×10⁻⁴ Pa, (3) Set accelerating voltage to operating value, (4) Auto gun alignment, (5) Calibrate EDS detector. Do not open chamber during pump cycle.
